751-3286-4927.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3968-4050-4078-6273.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-6273.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Embalmed Ascendant triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

2023-4289-4770-4885.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

116-512-1902.easyPrerequisites: Wirewood Channeler and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-1902.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
116-512-1902.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Wirewood Channeler, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-1902.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Wirewood Channeler's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1808-2837-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1808-2837-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1808-2837-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-6772-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

1116-2438-2738-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sek'Kuar, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4364-7715.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
4364-7715.description:
Declare Aurelia and The Mighty Thor as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Mighty Thor trigger, blinking Aurelia and causing it to enter tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Aurelia trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-4559-7824-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
413-4559-7824-7839.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Bard.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2178-5931-5970-6797.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2178-5931-5970-6797.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2178-5931-5970-6797.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

5686-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2366-4927-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4927-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

57-4235-4846-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4846-6965.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-4997-5078-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3532-4997-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

997-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

2457-3000-4321-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2724-3217-3582-6797.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

1497-3327-4613-5961.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-3327-4613-5961.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

813-3603-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Cloudshift.
813-3603-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

950-1486-1753-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
950-1486-1753-4875.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.
950-1486-1753-4875.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

955-1270-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

4188-5137-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
4188-5137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Accomplished Alchemist's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-647-1858-2056.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-647-1858-2056.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

1636-5470.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
1636-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

2923-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Furnace Queen.
Breath of Fury attached to another nontoken creature you control.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2923-3259.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the nontoken creature Ayara returned, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

722-3153-4089.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Sphinx of the Second Sun and Glasspool Mimic each trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and exiling Chronomantic Escape with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

678-1636-2459-5098.notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
678-1636-2459-5098.description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life and you to amass Orcs 2.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1124-2034-2242-4356.description:
Activate Elspeth's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Ral Zarek's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2366-3827-4558.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of creatures that can tap to produce at least {3}{R/W}{R/W}.
The mana-producing creatures cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2366-3827-4558.description:
Declare the mana-producing creatures as attackers.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Extus triggers, returning Dryad Arbor to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve Waves of Aggression, untapping all creatures that attacked this turn, and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Activate the mana-producing creatures by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R/W}{R/W}.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2499-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the first champion trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the second champion trigger, exiling the Lightning Crafter token.
When the Lightning Crafter token leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1562-2792-4331.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
1562-2792-4331.description:
Activate up to seven mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Great Whale, except it's an artifact.
When Machine God's Effigy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Machine God's Effigy from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

122-997-2324-5170.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver.
Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
Proper Burial and Junji trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Junji's toughness.
Resolve the Junji trigger, causing you to lose 2 life and to put Phyrexian Delver from your graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, causing you to return Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose five life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 4, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

557-3554-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Diabolic Revelation by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Diabolic Revelation and Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
